objective.name: sandbox.dsl.wrapper.matter.inputs
objective.description: Pass params and direct @matter refs into a wrapper-backed capacity.

#root.role: Call one wrapper-backed capacity with explicit params and explicit local and remote matter refs.

effects.wrapper_input_contract: The wrapper receives both params and injected @matter refs.

transformation_contract.morphing: A DSL request becomes an explicit reflection of the params and matter refs observed by the wrapper runtime.
invariants: The flow consists of a single wrapper invocation with explicit params and explicit local and remote @matter refs.
The terminal payload is the reflected wrapper input envelope returned by sandbox.inspect.inputs.
Both the local and remote matter refs are static in this scenario.
success: On success, the wrapper payload shows the params and @matter refs as observed after Execution-side injection.
Successful execution proves that DSL can pass explicit params plus explicit matter refs into a wrapper-backed call.
The terminal payload exposes received_params together with ctx_id and wrapper_name from sandbox.inspect.inputs.
failure: The flow fails if the single wrapper-backed inspection call cannot execute.
Invalid matter routing or wrapper execution errors close the scenario fail-closed.
notes: This is the direct static @matter injection oracle used by N7.
The scenario does not resolve matter content; it validates envelope construction.
